<style>
    .sc-placeholder{background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 8%,transparent);
      border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 50%,transparent);
      border-radius:2px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden}
    @keyframes sc-shine{0%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-placeholder,
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-interp.sc-missing{position:relative;
      background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 5%,transparent);
      border-color:transparent}
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-placeholder::before,
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-interp.sc-missing::before{content:'';
      position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(217,119,87,0) 25%,rgba(247,225,211,.95) 37%,rgba(217,119,87,0) 63%);
      background-size:400% 100%;animation:sc-shine 1.4s ease infinite}
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-placeholder:nth-child(n+9 of .sc-placeholder)::before,
    html.sc-dc-streaming .sc-interp.sc-missing:nth-child(n+9 of .sc-interp.sc-missing)::before{animation:none;
      background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 8%,transparent)}
    .sc-placeholder-error{padding:4px 8px;font:11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;
      color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 70%,transparent);word-break:break-word}
    .sc-interp.sc-missing{display:inline-block;width:2em;height:1em;overflow:hidden;
      vertical-align:text-bottom;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.5);
      border-radius:2px;box-sizing:border-box;color:transparent;
      user-select:none}
    .sc-interp.sc-unresolved{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:.85em;
      color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 50%,transparent);
      background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 10%,transparent);border-radius:3px;
      padding:0 3px}
    .sc-host.sc-has-error{position:relative}
    .sc-logic-error{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2147483647;max-width:60ch;
      padding:6px 10px;background:#b00020;color:#fff;font:12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;
      border-radius:4px;white-space:pre-wrap;pointer-events:none}
    /* Mirrors PRINT_BASELINE_CSS in apps/web deck-stage-export.ts — keep both
       in sync until dc-runtime regains a build step. */
    @media print {
      @page { margin: 0.5cm; }
      figure, table { break-inside: avoid; }
      #dc-root, #dc-root > .sc-host { height: auto; }
      *, *::before, *::after {
        print-color-adjust: exact; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
        backdrop-filter: none !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
        animation-delay: -99s !important; animation-duration: .001s !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; animation-fill-mode: both !important;
        animation-play-state: running !important; transition-duration: 0s !important;
      }
    }
  </style>

<style data-dc-tpl="5">:root{
  /* Radii — the system is essentially square. --radius is 2px; pills are the only curve. */
  --radius: 0.125rem;
  --radius-sm: calc(var(--radius) - 2px);
  --radius-md: var(--radius);

  --grain-opacity: 0.28; /* @kind other */

  <div data-dc-tpl="72" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 28px;">
    <p data-dc-tpl="73" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--lime);">01 — What matters</p>
    <h2 data-dc-tpl="74" class="display" style="margin: 20px 0px 8px; font-size: var(--display-2); color: var(--text-strong);">Five findings</h2>
    <div data-dc-tpl="75" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 64px; height: 5px; background: var(--lime); margin: 0px 0px 56px;"></div>

    <ol data-dc-tpl="76" style="list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: grid; gap: 1px; background: var(--hairline); border: 1px solid var(--hairline);">
      <li data-dc-tpl="77" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 3fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="78">
          <p data-dc-tpl="79" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; color: var(--lime);">01</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="80" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--text-strong);">The bottleneck is demand and execution, not production</h3>
          <p data-dc-tpl="81" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">Contract manufacturing in Brazil and a third-party logistics partner already remove the capital and expertise barriers: <em data-dc-tpl="82">“I don’t need to have my own warehouse… I don’t have to train shoemakers”</em> (~08:47). The constraint Desirée named is <em data-dc-tpl="83">“really just getting that machine to be a well-oiled machine”</em> — and specifically, <em data-dc-tpl="84">“how are we driving demand in a way that we can responsibly manufacture product where we’re not wasting.”</em> That is a marketing, demand-planning and decision-support problem.</p>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="85">
          <span data-dc-tpl="86" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); color: var(--text-soft); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Stated</span>
          <p data-dc-tpl="87" style="margin: 16px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-soft);">Transcript ~08:47, E037–E044. Team size, current spend and any sell-through data behind this are not on the record.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li data-dc-tpl="88" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 3fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="89">
          <p data-dc-tpl="90" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; color: var(--lime);">02</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="91" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--text-strong);">The raise is decided, not yet live</h3>
          <p data-dc-tpl="92" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">On the record: <em data-dc-tpl="93">“I’m actually about to launch a crowd equity funding campaign… the money will be used to launch a new collection, new styles and really scale up the brand”</em> (~01:08). On 13 August 2026 a founder-authored Instagram post named FrontFundr as the platform and placed the raise at the “back end logistics” stage — offering documents, share value, minimum investment. No live FrontFundr listing for Voes & Co was found as of this research.</p>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="94">
          <span data-dc-tpl="95" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Verified</span>
          <span data-dc-tpl="96" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Unconfirmed</span>
          <p data-dc-tpl="97" style="margin: 16px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-soft);">Platform and stage verified (<a data-dc-tpl="98" href="#s05">source 05</a>). Target, minimum investment, instrument and timing are not published anywhere we looked.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li data-dc-tpl="99" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 3fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="100">
          <p data-dc-tpl="101" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; color: var(--lime);">03</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="102" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--text-strong);">A second product line is arriving in the same window</h3>
          <p data-dc-tpl="103" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">A post referencing 20 August 2026 shows first prototypes of a “Brooklyn sneaker” — <em data-dc-tpl="104">“an extension of our collection featuring a gender neutral style.”</em> One week after the FrontFundr decision. A brand that has been a single-silhouette Chelsea-boot business since its Kickstarter now has a concrete launch to run while it prepares an offering.</p>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="105">
          <span data-dc-tpl="106" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Verified</span>
          <p data-dc-tpl="107" style="margin: 16px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-soft);">Instagram, via search snippet (<a data-dc-tpl="108" href="#s06">source 06</a>). Launch date, price and production run are not public.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li data-dc-tpl="109" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 3fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="110">
          <p data-dc-tpl="111" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; color: var(--lime);">04</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="112" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--text-strong);">The capability she wants most is marketing — and its inputs are not written down</h3>
          <p data-dc-tpl="113" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">Asked what she would build first: <em data-dc-tpl="114">“a built-in, really smart marketing agent”</em> that takes “hey, we’re launching a sneaker” and returns strategy, budget and geography recommendations, formats and copy — lifting <em data-dc-tpl="115">“a base level skill… up like five notches”</em> (~37:00). In the same conversation she named the prerequisite she does not yet consider settled: <em data-dc-tpl="116">“do you have your brand, like what’s your brand tone, what’s your voice”</em> (~29:17). Current AI use, in her own words, is <em data-dc-tpl="117">“level two maybe”</em> (~19:26).</p>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="118">
          <span data-dc-tpl="119" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); color: var(--text-soft); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Stated</span>
          <p data-dc-tpl="120" style="margin: 16px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-soft);">E116, E123–E127, E070. Whether any brand-voice documentation exists in written form is unknown. She described this as a wish, not a purchase.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li data-dc-tpl="121" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 3fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px; align-items: start;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="122">
          <p data-dc-tpl="123" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; color: var(--lime);">05</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="124" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--text-strong);">The 2024 expansion plan has no public follow-through</h3>
          <p data-dc-tpl="125" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">In March 2024 the founder told FOLIO.YVR she saw the brand <em data-dc-tpl="126">“heading into 2025 with a solid and ambitious plan to build in Europe and launch another one to two styles,”</em> with <em data-dc-tpl="127">“a few sales partners in South America.”</em> Eighteen months on, no European or South American channel appears in any source reviewed. On the record she is still asking whether Australia or Europe would need manufacturing closer to market (~08:47), and describes the customer base as “mostly Canada and the United States.”</p>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="128">
          <span data-dc-tpl="129" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; background: var(--lime); color: var(--ink); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Verified</span>
          <span data-dc-tpl="130" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Unconfirmed</span>
          <p data-dc-tpl="131" style="margin: 16px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-soft);">The 2024 statement is verified (<a data-dc-tpl="132" href="#s08">source 08</a>). Its status is not: absence from public sources is a discovery question, not a finding of failure.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div></section><section data-dc-tpl="133" style="padding: 72px 0px 88px;">

    <p data-dc-tpl="135" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 32px; color: var(--muted-foreground);">The numbers that anchor this report</p>

  <div data-dc-tpl="154" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 28px;">
    <p data-dc-tpl="155" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--ink-faint);">02 — The window</p>
    <h2 data-dc-tpl="156" class="display" style="margin: 20px 0px 8px; font-size: var(--display-2); color: var(--ink);">Three clocks, one season</h2>
    <div data-dc-tpl="157" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 64px; height: 5px; background: var(--lime); margin: 0px 0px 56px;"></div>

    <div data-dc-tpl="158" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 56px;">
      <div data-dc-tpl="159" style="flex: 1 1 300px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="160" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Clock one — the raise</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="161" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Platform chosen and announced publicly on 13 August 2026. Proceeds, in her words, for “a new collection, new styles” and to “reach bigger markets.” The offering is framed as inviting “conscious women to join me as owners.”</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="162" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Missing: target, minimum ticket, instrument, valuation and open date. Any counterparty will ask for these first.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="163" style="flex: 1 1 300px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="164" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Clock two — the sneaker</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="165" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">First Brooklyn prototypes received around 20 August 2026. A new silhouette means a new production batch, a new size curve and a new launch — the first real test of any marketing capability the brand builds.</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="166" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Missing: launch date, run size and the demand signal that would size it. The founder’s own rule — no “thousands of shoes that don’t get sold” — makes that signal the constraint.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="167" style="flex: 1 1 300px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="168" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Clock three — the markets</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="169" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Europe and South America were named as 2025 targets in March 2024. On the record in September 2026 the question has become whether Australia or Europe would require manufacturing nearer to market.</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="170" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Missing: whether any of it happened. If the raise funds “bigger markets,” the sequencing of those markets is a decision the offering will have to describe.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div data-dc-tpl="171" style="margin-top: 64px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline-dark); padding-top: 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px;">
      <p data-dc-tpl="172" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Our inference, stated as such</p>
      <p data-dc-tpl="173" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink);">Each clock is separately documented and dated. The claim that they compound — that a raise, a launch and a market decision arriving together is the moment operational leverage matters most, for better or worse — is <strong data-dc-tpl="174">our reading, not Desirée’s</strong>. Neither speaker called it a window. Discovery should try to disprove it.</p>

  <div data-dc-tpl="176" style="max-width: 1400px; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px 28px;">
    <p data-dc-tpl="177" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--lime);">03 — The ledger</p>
    <h2 data-dc-tpl="178" class="display" style="margin: 20px 0px 8px; font-size: var(--display-2); color: var(--text-strong);">What we could confirm — and what we could not</h2>
    <div data-dc-tpl="179" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 64px; height: 5px; background: var(--lime); margin: 0px 0px 56px;"></div>

    <div data-dc-tpl="180" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1px; background: var(--hairline); border: 1px solid var(--hairline);">
      <div data-dc-tpl="181" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 36px 30px; flex: 1 1 320px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="182" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 24px; color: var(--lime);">Confirmed</p>
        <ul data-dc-tpl="183" style="list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: grid; gap: 18px;">

    <p data-dc-tpl="212" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--ink-faint);">04 — Where an engagement would earn its fee</p>
    <h2 data-dc-tpl="213" class="display" style="margin: 20px 0px 8px; font-size: var(--display-2); color: var(--ink);">Four opportunities, in the order she named them</h2>
    <div data-dc-tpl="214" aria-hidden="true" style="width: 64px; height: 5px; background: var(--lime); margin: 0px 0px 24px;"></div>
    <p data-dc-tpl="215" style="margin: 0px 0px 56px; max-width: 72ch; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Ordered by how directly the founder raised them, not by assumed size. No dollar value is estimated anywhere below.</p>

    <div data-dc-tpl="216" style="display: grid; gap: 1px; background: var(--hairline-dark); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-dark);">
      <div data-dc-tpl="217" style="background: var(--cream); padding: 40px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 48px;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="218">
          <p data-dc-tpl="219" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Opportunity A</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="220" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--ink);">A defined launch capability, timed to the Brooklyn sneaker</h3>
          <span data-dc-tpl="221" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-dark); color: var(--ink-body); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Stated priority</span>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="222">
          <p data-dc-tpl="223" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">She described it herself: give it “hey, we’re launching a sneaker” and get back strategy, budget and geography, creative formats and copy — work a junior can then run five notches above their base skill, without a senior hire. The sneaker is a live launch, so the capability can be tested on real work rather than an exercise.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="224" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Before any tool is chosen, define the inputs. She named them: brand tone and voice, a budget envelope, target geography. She also said they are not yet settled.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="225" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-faint);">To validate: whether brand-voice documentation exists in any written form; team capacity; current marketing spend. Benefit is a hypothesis until piloted.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="226" style="background: var(--cream); padding: 40px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 48px;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="227">
          <p data-dc-tpl="228" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Opportunity B</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="229" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--ink);">Demand and production decisions ahead of new markets</h3>
          <span data-dc-tpl="230" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-dark); color: var(--ink-body); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Stated</span>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="231">
          <p data-dc-tpl="232" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Proceeds are meant for new styles and bigger markets; expansion to Australia or Europe would, in her view, reopen the manufacturing-location question; and the brand’s own rule is no dumped stock. Those three together make expansion a decision-support need, not a manufacturing one.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="233" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">The concept: pair whatever sell-through data exists with batch-size and market-sequencing questions, so a production run is sized by signal rather than ambition. A view to scope in discovery, not a system to build.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="234" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-faint);">To validate: what sales and inventory data exists and where it lives; the status of the 2024 Europe and South America plan. Cannot be sized without it.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="235" style="background: var(--cream); padding: 40px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 48px;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="236">
          <p data-dc-tpl="237" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Opportunity C</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="238" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--ink);">An operating narrative the offering can carry</h3>
          <span data-dc-tpl="239" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--ink); color: var(--ink); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Host view</span>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="240">
          <p data-dc-tpl="241" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Shane’s observation from his own raising: investors now ask “how are you running AI in the back” before they look at the product, because <em data-dc-tpl="242">“if you don’t understand how to do that in the back, you’re going to be careless with their money”</em> (~40:45). Desirée agreed with the economics underneath it: <em data-dc-tpl="243">“a huge part of investor money or the capital in any organization is labor”</em> (~41:25).</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="244" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">If that pattern holds for a Canadian retail equity-crowdfunding raise — a real if — a plain-language account of how the business runs belongs in the offering materials she is drafting now. We propose nothing further here; we have not seen FrontFundr’s requirements or her draft documents.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="245" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-faint);">To validate: whether retail “conscious” investors weigh back-end operations the way institutional investors do. Hypothesis, not recommendation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="246" style="background: var(--cream); padding: 40px 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 48px;">
        <div data-dc-tpl="247">
          <p data-dc-tpl="248" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; color: var(--ink-faint);">Opportunity D</p>
          <h3 data-dc-tpl="249" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: var(--display-4); color: var(--ink);">The sizing and returns data a footwear brand cannot avoid generating</h3>
          <span data-dc-tpl="250" class="eyebrow" style="display: inline-block; border: 1px dashed var(--hairline-dark); color: var(--ink-soft-text); padding: 4px 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em;">Inference</span>
        </div>
        <div data-dc-tpl="251">
          <p data-dc-tpl="252" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">She raised the idea herself as a future intention: <em data-dc-tpl="253">“AI modeling to make someone feel really confident… so that we decrease the amount of returns”</em> (~13:56). Every shoe sold online produces a size-and-return record. A second silhouette will produce a second size curve.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="254" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Nothing on the record says that data is captured anywhere structured. For a business this size the return rate is both the highest-leverage number and the one a non-specialist understands immediately. If it were ever connected to the production decision in Opportunity B, the decision about which sizes and styles to make could improve over time. Speculative, and untested.</p>
          <p data-dc-tpl="255" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-faint);">To validate: whether returns are tracked at all, volumes, channel mix, who holds the data — the brand, the 3PL, or the storefront.</p>
        </div>

    </div>

    <p data-dc-tpl="258" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--lime);">05 — The priority capability, and what stays human</p>
    <h2 data-dc-tpl="259" class="display" style="margin: 20px 0px 8px; font-size: var(--display-2); color: var(--text-strong);">One launch, done deliberately</h2>

    <p data-dc-tpl="261" style="margin: 0px 0px 56px; max-width: 72ch; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">A concept for exploration, scoped narrowly around real near-term work — the Brooklyn sneaker and whatever collection follows the raise. Not a workflow specification and not a committed deliverable.</p>

    <div data-dc-tpl="262" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1px; background: var(--hairline); border: 1px solid var(--hairline);">
      <div data-dc-tpl="263" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 32px 28px; flex: 1 1 240px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="264" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--lime);">Goes in</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="265" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text-body);">A documented brand voice and tone. A budget envelope per launch. Target geography and market order. The product specification for the new style.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="266" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 32px 28px; flex: 1 1 240px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="267" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--lime);">Happens</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="268" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text-body);">Inputs become a campaign brief. Creative direction and copy are drafted. A media plan — formats, sizing, first cities — is assembled for review. The shape she described at ~37:00.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="269" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 32px 28px; flex: 1 1 240px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="270" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--lime);">Comes out</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="271" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text-body);">A draft brief and creative package for Desirée or a designated marketer to approve — not to rubber-stamp.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="272" style="background: var(--ink); padding: 32px 28px; flex: 1 1 240px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="273" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; color: var(--text-strong);">Stays human</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="274" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text-body);">Budget approval. Brand-voice guardrails. Creative direction. Which partners and materials fit the brand’s values. Every investor-facing decision. Her own precedent for directing AI-generated design concepts — <em data-dc-tpl="275">“there’s always still going to be the need for the human interaction”</em> (~31:32) — is how she already works.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div data-dc-tpl="276" style="margin-top: 64px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline); padding-top: 36px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 40px;">
      <p data-dc-tpl="277" class="eyebrow" style="margin: 0px; color: var(--text-muted);">Governance, regardless of tool</p>
      <div data-dc-tpl="278">
        <p data-dc-tpl="279" style="margin: 0px 0px 16px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">Two questions raised on the record travel with any future work. Resilience: <em data-dc-tpl="280">“If Claude goes down and Claude Cowork goes down, what are you going to do?”</em> (~30:05). Judgment: the risk of losing critical thinking when output is accepted uncritically. Neither depends on which tools are eventually chosen.</p>
        <p data-dc-tpl="281" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--text-body);">Our own rule, stated on the same recording: deep organisational transformation rather than point solutions for businesses that are not ready, and people first — to the point of sending a client elsewhere if we cannot get them the result (~27:37, ~28:45). That is positioning, not a commitment of scope.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div></section><section data-dc-tpl="282" class="section-cream on-cream" data-screen-label="06 Sequence" style="padding: 88px 0px;">

        <p data-dc-tpl="292" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Establish the basics section 03 lists as missing: brand-voice documentation, team size and workload, tools and spend today, the real FrontFundr timeline, and what sell-through and returns data exists.</p>

      <div data-dc-tpl="293" style="flex: 1 1 260px;">

        <h3 data-dc-tpl="295" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; font-size: 1.375rem; color: var(--ink);">Baseline</h3>
        <p data-dc-tpl="296" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Measure how long a launch cycle takes now, and what “level two” means in practice. Nothing is improved that was not first counted.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="297" style="flex: 1 1 260px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="298" class="display-black" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--lime);">03</p>
        <h3 data-dc-tpl="299" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; font-size: 1.375rem; color: var(--ink);">Refine the blueprint</h3>
        <p data-dc-tpl="300" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Replace every hypothesis in this document with a validated fact or strike it. Reconcile the record — one brand spelling, one origin story, no unsourced statistics — before the offering repeats any of them.</p>
      </div>
      <div data-dc-tpl="301" style="flex: 1 1 260px;">
        <p data-dc-tpl="302" class="display-black" style="margin: 0px 0px 14px; font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--lime);">04</p>
        <h3 data-dc-tpl="303" class="display" style="margin: 0px 0px 12px; font-size: 1.375rem; color: var(--ink);">Then one pilot</h3>
        <p data-dc-tpl="304" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">On the single highest-priority capability discovery confirms — most likely the launch capability, on the sneaker — under agreed scope. Last, deliberately: automating on top of undefined inputs multiplies the noise, not the reach.</p>

      </div>

        <p data-dc-tpl="314" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Return and exchange rate, if sizing-confidence work is ever scoped.</p>

        <p data-dc-tpl="317" style="margin: 0px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-body);">Completeness of the operating narrative in the investor materials before the raise opens.</p>

    <p data-dc-tpl="318" style="margin: 28px 0px 0px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-faint);">Hypotheses to test in discovery, not committed KPIs.</p>
  </div></section><section data-dc-tpl="319" class="grain" data-screen-label="07 The strategic question" style="padding: 104px 0px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);">
